We further assess the performance of XoT across various base models, such as Llama-2 series (Touvron et al., 2023b). The results are shown in Table 10, and we illustrate the performance scaling curve in Figure 8. With less capable models, different prompting methods still demonstrate strong complementarity under oracle setting. Our observations suggest that smaller models tend to yield suboptimal results, likely due to the unbalanced performance across different reasoning approaches
